scales.name: Episodicity
scales.definition: Degree to which energy, confidence and output arrive in distinct phases rather than at a steady level.

bodyLinks.mechanism: No direct transmitter claim. The scale is justified predictively: the Hypomanic Personality Scale was the single best predictor of later bipolar disorder in a 23-year birth-cohort follow-up (d = 0.67).
bodyLinks.verification: Clinical assessment at the high end; prospective mood charting.

items.text: My energy and confidence come in waves rather than staying level.
items.informantText: Their energy and confidence come in waves rather than staying level.

items.text: My energy is about the same from one month to the next.
items.informantText: Their energy is about the same from one month to the next.

items.text: There are weeks when I get far more done than I usually do.
items.informantText: There are weeks when they get far more done than they usually do.

review.notes: Boundary with A1 Drive: high steady drive also produces productive weeks. The discriminating feature is variability, not level — if this item correlates more with A1 than with the rest of A8, it is measuring Drive.

items.text: People who know me would describe me as even-keeled over time.
items.informantText: People who know them would describe them as even-keeled over time.

items.text: I'm about as sociable and talkative in one month as in any other.
items.informantText: They're about as sociable and talkative in one month as in any other.

items.text: There are stretches when I need noticeably less sleep and don't feel tired.
items.informantText: There are stretches when they need noticeably less sleep and don't seem tired.

review.notes: The discriminating item for this scale, per the construct sheet: reduced sleep *need* without fatigue, as distinct from insomnia. Must not be answerable by someone who simply sleeps badly — cognitive interviews should confirm the 'don't feel tired' clause is doing that work.

items.text: My sense of what I'm capable of has stayed steady my whole life.
items.informantText: Their sense of what they're capable of has stayed steady their whole life.

review.notes: Lifetime framing, applying the A4 r08 pattern: a 'never' claim resists current-state contamination in both directions. Reworded to remove a negation: agreeing with "I don't ..." makes the disagree side a double negative, which is a known source of respondent error. The pole and keying are unchanged; only the phrasing is now a positive assertion of the same thing.

items.text: After a very productive spell I usually crash.
items.informantText: After a very productive spell they usually crash.

items.text: My output is steady — I don't really have peaks and troughs.
items.informantText: Their output is steady — they don't really have peaks and troughs.

review.notes: Externally-driven variation (shift work, seasonal work, caregiving cycles) produces peaks and troughs without episodicity. Context intake must capture work pattern before this scale is interpreted.

items.text: In my most energetic phases I've made decisions I later couldn't explain.
items.informantText: In their most energetic phases they've made decisions they later couldn't explain.

review.notes: Highest-information item on the scale and the one that feeds the pre-specified interaction rule (high A1 + low A3 + high A8 + impairment → suggest assessment). Deliberately describes consequence rather than using clinical language.

items.text: People close to me can tell when one of my phases is starting.
items.informantText: People close to them can tell when one of their phases is starting.

items.text: Even at my busiest, I feel like the same person I always am.
items.informantText: Even at their busiest, they seem like the same person they always are.

review.notes: Reworded to remove a negation: agreeing with "I don't ..." makes the disagree side a double negative, which is a known source of respondent error. The pole and keying are unchanged; only the phrasing is now a positive assertion of the same thing.

citations.title: Predictive and discriminant validity of psychopathology and temperament scales — 23-year follow-up, Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1966
citations.claim: High Hypomanic Personality Scale score was the best single predictor of later bipolar disorder (d = 0.67).
